differences.openwhisper: Command Mode and transforms can use the selected installed-agent cleanup provider to rewrite selected text with dictionary and caret context.
differences.fiorivoce: An approved CLI can clean live dictation started with the local UI or a hotkey. It receives the spoken words and cleanup instructions. The app keeps surrounding text, selections, learned global rules and dictionary entries local. Command Mode and transforms use the selected text-model endpoint.
differences.reason: The person dictating chooses which installed agent may receive their speech. Rewriting text selected in another application requires separate authorization.
